items.title: Forgotten Bootloaders Expose Secure Boot Blind Spot
items.description: Nearly a dozen vulnerable and now revoked UEFI shim bootloaders remained trusted for years, giving attackers a path to bypass Secure Boot.

items.title: Identity Attacks Overtake Exploits as Top Ransomware Cause
items.description: Email attacks overtook exploits as the top ransomware root cause last year. Multifactor authentication (MFA) was deployed in 97% of credential-based attacks but failed to prevent compromise.

items.title: Zoom warns of critical account takeover vulnerability

items.title: Hackers Expanding Destiny Stealer Across the US and Europe. Is Your Organization Ready to Defend?
items.description: Destiny Stealer activity is rising across Europe and the US, putting corporate accounts, remote access, email data, and sensitive business information at risk. A single infected endpoint can expose passwords, session cookies, VPN details, Outlook data, cryptocurrency wallets, Wi-Fi profiles, and desktop screenshots. items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra Builds Full Chrome Exploit Chain From Security Patches
items.description: OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra model independently constructed a complete, working exploit chain for Google Chrome, using nothing but publicly available security patch commits as its starting point. Researchers from Hacktron tasked three frontier AI models, GPT-5.6 Sol Medium, Sol Ultra, and Grok 4.5, with a real-world offensive security challenge: analyze V8 (Chrome’s JavaScript engine)…
